intro x y
cases le_total x y with hxy hyx
· intro h
  have h1 : f x ≤ f y := h₂ (Ici 0) x y h
  contrapositive
  intro h'
  rw [h'] at h1
  exact le_irrefl (f y) h1
· intro h
  have h1 : f y ≤ f x := h₂ (Ici 0) y x h
  contrapositive
  intro h'
  rw [h'] at h1
  exact le_irrefl (f x) h1
